title: Obscure concurrency bug: token refresh race

defects.description: Check-then-act race on the `refreshing` flag: two concurrent getToken() calls can both observe `refreshing === false` before either sets it to true, so both start a refresh against the same oldToken.

Server invalidates the old token as soon as the first refresh request is received, so the second concurrent refresh call (using the same now-invalidated oldToken) fails, producing an intermittent logout.

Waiting callers use a fixed 50ms sleep then return currentToken, with no guarantee the in-flight refresh has completed by then -- they can return a stale/invalid token instead of waiting on the actual refresh.
